subject: [PATCH v7 4/6] fuse: support registered buffer pools in io-uring

2026-08-17.patch_summary: This patch adds support for registered buffer pools in the io-uring interface of the FUSE file system. It allows servers to use a buffer pool that is also registered through io-uring, eliminating the overhead of pinning and unpining user pages per I/O request. The server can register a buffer pool by setting the FUSE_URING_REGISTERED_BUFPOOL flag when adding a bufpool, and then passing the index of the registered bufpool in every sqe submitted. This results in improved write performance, with direct-I/O throughput increasing by up to 45% compared to the baseline.
